newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Expressway float 37X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Expressway float 37X subscribed.

text.p: Shenzhen Expressway Co Ltd said on Tuesday its public offer of 65 million H-shares in Hong Kong was 36.68 times subscribed.
Due to the response, Shenzhen Expressway said it had re-allocated 130 million H-shares from the placing portion to the Hong Kong public offering portion.
The company said the shares had been fixed at HK$2.20 each. Trading in the shares is due to begin on March 12.

Shenzhen Expressway issued 650 million H-shares at HK$2.00 to HK$2.20 per share in flotation. Ten percent of the issue was offered to the public in Hong Kong and 90 percent to professional and institutional investors.
The company operates and manages two class one highways and has a 55 percent stake in two cooperative expressway joint ventures in Shenzhen in southeastern China.
